description: A 40x40 box, gray by default, that turns teal under @media (min-width: 60px) -- which the 80px-wide viewport this fixture declares satisfies -- while a second @media (min-width: 5000px) block (declaring a red top border) never matches at that viewport. Proves both that a real @media query is evaluated against the real viewport this crate now threads through, not a hardcoded placeholder, and that a non-matching query truly has no effect.

florui.css: .box { width: 40px; height: 40px; background-color: #808080; } @media (min-width: 60px) { .box { background-color: #2f7d6c; } } @media (min-width: 5000px) { .box { border-top-width: 6px; border-top-style: solid; border-top-color: #ff0000; } }
